result.title: Epidemiology and risk factors for thromboembolic complications of childhood nephrotic syndrome: a Midwest Pediatric Nephrology Consortium (MWPNC) study.
result.abstractText: In this multicenter study of children with nephrotic syndrome from the Midwest Pediatric Nephrology Consortium (MWPNC), thromboembolic complications occurred in 2.8% of patients. Children aged > 12 years are at much greater risk of thromboembolism.
